sources.entry: Edmund - Minimal, native macOS Markdown editor with live preview; works with your existing files, no vault. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/I7T5/Edmund) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]
Edmund - Minimal, native macOS Markdown editor with live preview that works with your existing files, no vault.

summary.one_liner: Edmund is a minimal, file-based, native macOS Markdown editor with inline live preview that works on existing .md files without requiring a vault.
summary.what_it_does: Edmund opens .md files from any location on disk, with no vault or dedicated folder required, and renders Markdown inline as you edit in a Typora/Obsidian-style live preview. The README says it is written in 100% Swift on AppKit and TextKit 2, with no Electron and minimal dependencies. Math and Obsidian syntax support are opt-in. Privacy features include offline operation by default, optional blocking of external links, and optional HTML sanitization. The README also says it checks for updates automatically and can be installed via a DMG or Homebrew cask. It is described as beta, and an extensions system is listed as upcoming.
use_cases: editing Markdown notes on a Mac
working with .md files scattered across folders
Obsidian-style note editing without a vault
lightweight native alternative to Electron Markdown apps
how_to_run: Alternatively: download Edmund.dmg from the latest release and drag Edmund.app to Applications
notable: Inline live preview in the style of Typora and Obsidian
File-based: opens .md files anywhere, no vaults
Native 100% Swift build on AppKit and TextKit 2, with no Electron
Offline by default, with optional external link blocking and HTML sanitization
Opt-in math and Obsidian syntax support
caveats: Currently in beta, per the README
The app is not code-signed, so macOS may report it as damaged and require a manual bypass step (System Settings or xattr command)
Extensions system is listed as coming soon, not yet available
